A tribal '''circle''', also known as a '''Sith tribe''', was a principal social group of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], each lead by one or more [[Sith sorcerer]]s who were responsible for the safety and protection of their people.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
